title: Map of St. Lawrence Island and Cape Chaplina, observation on heading 283° true
description: Inked map on an Air Intelligence Information Report (5004th Air Intel Sv Sq, IR 5004-42-53, Incl #1) showing "ST. LAWRENCE ISLAND" and the U.S.S.R. coastline at "CAPE CHAPLINA," separated by a dashed "INTERNATIONAL DATE LINE." An arrow from "GAMBELL" on the island points northwest, labeled "OBSERVATION ON HEADING 283° TRUE." A north arrow and "SCALE: 1" = 13.7 NM" are included; the form is marked Unclassified.
